subject.title: feat: add Google Cloud Run sandbox provider

question: Should Crabbox support the public-preview Cloud Run Sandbox provider and its shared-secret remote gateway as a built-in provider contract?
rationale: The patch is a new user-facing provider and remote execution surface, so code review cannot determine the repository’s long-term support, preview-stability, and gateway-security commitment.

options.title: Adopt with explicit gateway review
options.body: Approve the built-in provider after aligning the documented URL configuration with code, adding focused fresh-setup coverage, and accepting the gateway authentication and operator contract.

options.title: Defer until the upstream API stabilizes
options.body: Keep the contribution open or close it as deferred until Cloud Run Sandbox is no longer preview-only and maintainers want to support its gateway lifecycle.

options.title: Narrow to direct in-container support
options.body: Accept only a clearly documented direct-mode integration if maintainers do not want to own the remote gateway protocol.

recommendation.title: Adopt with explicit gateway review
recommendation.body: Approve the built-in provider after aligning the documented URL configuration with code, adding focused fresh-setup coverage, and accepting the gateway authentication and operator contract.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the only identified person with concrete implementation knowledge of the new provider and can clarify the proposed gateway contract while maintainers make the product decision.
